newsitem.title: USA: National Fuel unit buys Czech utility stake.
newsitem.headline: National Fuel unit buys Czech utility stake.

text.p: National Fuel Gas Co on Friday said one of its subsidiaries bought an interest in a power and heating utility in the Czech Republic.
The company said the purchase was part of a strategy to develop energy projects in central Europe.
It said in a statement that a unit of its Horizon Energy Development Inc subsidiary acquired a "strategic" interest in Severoceske Teplarny, a utility in the northern Bohemia region.
A National Fuel Gas spokeswoman said the interest represented 34 percent of the utility. She declined to disclose the value of the purchase.
The unit had previously acquired Kromeriz, a heating plant in the southeastern Moravia region of the Czech Republic, it said.
"Horizon expects that the ownership of these plants will provide a strong base for further expansion and development of energy projects in central Europe," it said.
Horizon Energy is engaged in the development and acquisition of energy projects in the United States and other countries.
